import sys
import math
import itertools

MOD = 1000000007
INV = 570000004

# Read input
n = int(sys.stdin.readline())

p = [[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(n):
    row = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] = (row[j] * INV) % MOD

# Initialize permutations
permsA = []
permsB = []

aah = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
t = 0
for perm in itertools.permutations(aah):
    if perm[0] < perm[1] < perm[2] and perm[3] < perm[4] < perm[5]:
        permsA.append(list(perm[:3]))
        permsB.append(list(perm[3:]))
        t += 1

# Fill remaining p entries
for i in range(6):
    for j in range(6):
        if i == j:
            p[i][j] = 1
        elif i >= n or j >= n:
            p[i][j] = 0

# Initialize arrays
size = 1 << 18
bmA = [0] * (1 << 18)
bmB = [0] * (1 << 18)
f = [0] * (1 << 20)

# Precompute probabilities and bitmasks
for mask in range(size):
    prob1 = 1
    prob2 = 1
    bm1 = 0
    bm2 = 0
    for j in range(6):
        for k in range(3):
            res = j * 3 + k
            if (mask & (1 << res)):
                prob1 = (prob1 * p[j][k]) % MOD
                prob2 = (prob2 * p[j][k + 3]) % MOD
            else:
                prob1 = (prob1 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k])) % MOD
                prob2 = (prob2 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k + 3])) % MOD

    for ot in range(20):
        ord_list = [0, 1, 2]
        ok = False
        for perm_ord in itertools.permutations(ord_list):
            ok2 = True
            for j in range(3):
                val = permsA[ot][perm_ord[j]]
                loc = val * 3 + j
                if not (mask & (1 << loc)):
                    ok2 = False
                    break
            if ok2:
                ok = True
                break
        if ok:
            bm1 ^= (1 << ot)

    for ot in range(20):
        ord_list = [0, 1, 2]
        ok = False
        for perm_ord in itertools.permutations(ord_list):
            ok2 = True
            for j in range(3):
                val = permsB[ot][perm_ord[j]]
                loc = val * 3 + j
                if not (mask & (1 << loc)):
                    ok2 = False
                    break
            if ok:
                ok = True
                break
        if ok:
            bm2 ^= (1 << ot)

    bmA[bm1] = (bmA[bm1] + prob1) % MOD
    bmB[bm2] = (bmB[bm2] + prob2) % MOD

# Initialize f array
for i in range(1 << 20):
    f[i] = bmA[i]

# Fast Walsh–Hadamard transform
for i in range(20):
    for mask in range(1 << 20):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            f[mask] = (f[mask] + f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD

# Calculate final answer
sm = 0
full_mask = (1 << 20) - 1
for i in range(1 << 20):
    sm = (sm + bmB[i] * f[full_mask ^ i]) % MOD

print((1 + MOD - sm) % MOD)
